text: {"standards":[{"code":"W.6.3","verdict":"taught","reason":"In Learning in Action Part A, students finish their narrative and revise it for event sequence, transitions, and a conclusion that follows from the events, as the W.6.3 text requires."},{"code":"W.6.4","verdict":"taught","reason":"Part A's revision checklist and the Part B peer feedback checkpoint have students revise organization and style for their purpose and audience."},{"code":"RL.6.9","verdict":"partly","reason":"Students compare the Arachne myth with their own retelling using comparison frames in the Literacy Lab and Part B, but The Lightning Thief is only touched on in the launch question and homework, so the required comparison of different forms or genres is not really taught."}],"anchorText":{"verdict":"partly","reason":"The Lightning Thief appears in the Launch question about Percy's quest and in the optional Chapter 18 homework, but the main Activities use the Arachne model and student drafts rather than the novel."}}
